payoutCycle.description: First payout is eligible 14 days after placing the first trade on the funded account. Subsequent payouts occur bi-weekly.

warnings: Violating daily drawdown or overall max drawdown limits will result in instant account breach.
Accounts inactive for more than 30 consecutive days may be terminated.

requirements: Achieve at least 10% total profit over 3 consecutive months
Request at least 2 successful payouts during the period

faqs.question: How do payouts work at AquaFunded?
faqs.answer: Payouts can be requested through your dashboard using supported methods such as Rise Pay, Crypto (USDT), or Bank Wire. Once requested, payouts are processed within 24 hours.

seo.title: How do payouts work at AquaFunded?
seo.metaDescription: Learn how to request and receive payouts at AquaFunded using Crypto, Rise Pay, or Bank Wire.

faqs.question: What are the drawdown limits at AquaFunded?
faqs.answer: AquaFunded enforces maximum daily drawdown and total static/relative drawdown limits based on the selected account type. Exceeding these drawdown thresholds results in immediate breach of the account rules.

seo.title: What are the drawdown limits at AquaFunded?
seo.metaDescription: Understand AquaFunded daily and overall drawdown limit rules to keep your funded account active.

faqs.question: When can I request my first payout?
faqs.answer: Traders are eligible to request their first payout 14 calendar days after placing their first trade on the live funded account.

seo.title: When can I request my first payout at AquaFunded?
seo.metaDescription: Find out when you are eligible to request your first withdrawal after passing your AquaFunded challenge.

faqs.question: Is the challenge fee refunded on the first payout?
faqs.answer: Yes, AquaFunded refunds your initial evaluation challenge fee along with your first successful profit withdrawal.

seo.title: Is the challenge fee refunded on the first payout at AquaFunded?
seo.metaDescription: Learn about AquaFunded challenge fee refund policy on your first successful payout request.

pros: 100% refundable evaluation fee on first payout
cons: Strict maximum daily and total drawdown rules
Inactivity policy requires trading activity within 30 days
